mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed nerves and blood routes reaching the same muscles, connecting several earlier topics.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eye and ears was clear but fairly predictable; their routes to the brain had already been shown.

surprise.text: The diaphragm separates the chest from the abdomen, while nerves, vessels and the food pipe cross between them through their own routes.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The regional placements followed named spaces and previously shown connections, though the compatible options also guided the choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. The final body brought the connections together, though some fittings were predictable.
